image_urls.description: Optional first and last frame images for image-to-video mode. Provide 1 or 2 publicly accessible image URLs. Index 0 is mapped to the starting frame and index 1 is mapped to the optional ending frame. Supported image formats are JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, and AVIF; each image should be up to 30 MB. Cannot be used together with any reference_*_urls fields.

reference_image_urls.description: Optional reference image URLs for multimodal reference-to-video mode. Supports up to 9 publicly accessible images. Supported image formats are JPG, JPEG, PNG, and WebP; each image should be up to 30 MB. You can reference images in the prompt by order, such as @Image1 or @Image2. Cannot be used together with image_urls.

reference_video_urls.description: Optional reference video URLs for multimodal reference-to-video mode. Supports up to 3 publicly accessible MP4 or MOV files. The combined reference video duration should be 2 to 15 seconds total, total video size should be under 50 MB, and each video should be 480p to 720p. You can reference videos in the prompt by order, such as @Video1 or @Video2. Cannot be used together with image_urls.

reference_audio_urls.description: Optional reference audio URLs for multimodal reference-to-video mode. Supports up to 3 publicly accessible MP3 or WAV files. The combined reference audio duration should not exceed 15 seconds, and each file should be up to 15 MB. Audio references require at least one reference image or reference video. You can reference audio files in the prompt by order, such as @Audio1 or @Audio2. Cannot be used together with image_urls.

image_urls.description:
Reference image URLs for image-to-video on supported models.

- Supports public http/https URLs.

- Maximum 3 images.

- Frame mode: first image is the start frame, second image is the end frame.

- Maximum file size: 10MB.

- Supported formats: .jpeg, .jpg, .png, .webp.

- `veo3.1-lite` does not support this parameter; do not pass `image_urls`.

generation_type.description:
Video generation type.

- `frame`: Frame-to-video (two images).

- `reference`: Reference image-to-video (three images).

- If omitted, inferred by `image_urls` count: 2 for `frame`, 3 for `reference`.

- `veo3.1-quality` does not support `reference` mode.

- `veo3.1-lite` does not support this parameter; do not pass `generation_type`.

duration.description: Video duration in seconds. VEO 3.1 models on this page use 8 seconds.

resolution.description:
Output resolution.

- `720p`: Default.

- `1080p`: Full HD.

- `4k`: Ultra HD.

prompt.description: Generation prompt describing the desired output
prompt.example: A cinematic video scene

image_urls.description:
Image URLs for generation models.

- 1 image: image-to-video.

- 2 images: first/last-frame video. For `veo3.1-lite-official`, this mode supports duration 8 only.

- 3 images: `generation_type: "reference"` on supported models. This mode supports duration 8 only.

- `veo3.1-lite-official` supports at most 2 images.

generation_type.description:
Optional generation type for image-guided generation.

- `frame`: requires exactly 2 `image_urls`. For `veo3.1-lite-official`, `duration` must be 8.

- `reference`: requires exactly 3 `image_urls` and is not supported by `veo3.1-lite-official`.

If omitted, PoYo infers the mode from the number of `image_urls`; two images on `veo3.1-lite-official` still require `duration: 8`.

duration.description:
Generation duration in seconds.

- Generation models support 4, 6, or 8 seconds.

- `generation_type: "reference"` with three `image_urls` supports 8 seconds only.

- `veo3.1-lite-official` with two `image_urls` supports 8 seconds only, even when `generation_type` is omitted.

- `veo3.1-lite-official` with `resolution: "1080p"` supports 8 seconds only.
